activities.description: The narrator returns to the 'Red Light of Death' issue and explains the first step, which is to power off the phone.
The narrator demonstrates the next step, simultaneously holding volume up and the power button, then releasing the power button while still holding the volume up.

The narrator asks for feedback and mentions the possibility of a broken LCD panel if the solution doesn't work.
